mapper.select: select task_id as taskId, timestampdiff(second, create_time, sysdate()) as ageSeconds from review_task where task_status = 'PENDING' order by create_time asc, task_id asc limit 1

select task_status as status, count(*) as cnt from review_task where task_status in ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'SUPERSEDED') and ifnull(finished_time, update_time) >= date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{hours} hour) group by task_status

select count(*) from review_task where (task_status = 'RETRYING' or last_error_code in ('LEASE_EXPIRED', 'WORKER_SHUTDOWN', 'CONCURRENCY_LIMIT') or failure_type in ('LEASE_EXPIRED', 'WORKER_SHUTDOWN', 'CONCURRENCY_LIMIT')) and update_time >= date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{hours} hour)
select count(*) from review_task where (last_error_code = 'TIMEOUT' or failure_type = 'TIMEOUT') and update_time >= date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{hours} hour)

select sum(case when task_status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end) as successCount, sum(case when task_status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failedCount, sum(case when task_status = 'CANCELLED' then 1 else 0 end) as cancelledCount from review_task where task_status in ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') and ifnull(finished_time, update_time) >= date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{minutes} minute)

select delivery_id as deliveryId, task_id as taskId, timestampdiff(second, create_time, sysdate()) as ageSeconds from review_delivery_record where delivery_status = 'PENDING' order by create_time asc, delivery_id asc limit 1

select 'OVERDUE_PENDING' as kind, t.task_id as taskId, t.latest_run_id as runId, p.project_name as projectName, '待执行' as statusLabel, concat('任务已等待 ', timestampdiff(minute, t.create_time, sysdate()), ' 分钟') as summary, timestampdiff(second, t.create_time, sysdate()) as ageSeconds, t.create_time as createTime, t.next_run_at as nextRunAt from review_task t left join review_project p on p.project_id = t.project_id where t.task_status = 'PENDING' and t.create_time <= date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{ageMinutes} minute) order by t.create_time asc, t.task_id asc limit #{limit}

select 'LEASE_EXPIRED' as kind, t.task_id as taskId, t.latest_run_id as runId, p.project_name as projectName, '租约过期' as statusLabel, concat('执行中租约已过期，等待恢复扫描接管') as summary, timestampdiff(second, t.lease_until, sysdate()) as ageSeconds, t.create_time as createTime, t.lease_until as leaseUntil from review_task t left join review_project p on p.project_id = t.project_id where t.task_status = 'RUNNING' and t.lease_until is not null and t.lease_until < sysdate() order by t.lease_until asc, t.task_id asc limit #{limit}

select case when d.delivery_status = 'MANUAL' then 'DELIVERY_MANUAL' else 'DELIVERY_OVERDUE' end as kind, d.task_id as taskId, d.delivery_id as deliveryId, p.project_name as projectName, case when d.delivery_status = 'MANUAL' then '待人工处置' else '待投递超龄' end as statusLabel, ifnull(d.failure_message, concat('投递状态 ', d.delivery_status)) as summary, timestampdiff(second, d.create_time, sysdate()) as ageSeconds, d.create_time as createTime from review_delivery_record d left join review_project p on p.project_id = d.project_id where d.delivery_status = 'MANUAL' or (d.delivery_status = 'PENDING' and d.create_time <= date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{ageMinutes} minute)) order by case when d.delivery_status = 'MANUAL' then 0 else 1 end, d.create_time asc, d.delivery_id asc limit #{limit}
